note.zh-TW: 課程 Excel 版的應付款項週轉率以它為分子；年報公式版改用銷貨成本。
note.en: The course spreadsheet version of payables turnover uses it as the numerator; the annual report formula uses cost of sales instead.

definition.zh-TW: 這段期間買進來的商品成本。它加上期初存貨、減掉期末存貨，就是模板上的營業成本。
definition.en: The cost of goods bought during the period. Adding opening inventories and deducting closing inventories gives cost of sales on the template.
